name: Plainville Summer Recreation Program
description_short: A town-run summer day program for children entering grades 1–8. It runs weekdays at Plainville Town Park for 8 weeks, with sports, games, arts and crafts, daily swimming in the town pool, and one field trip each week.
refund_policy_summary: The $50 deposit per week per child is non-refundable. Cancelling a week requires at least one week's notice; if you cancel later, you pay the full fee for the week(s) missed.
swim_waterfront_notes: Daily pool time in the town pool is included in the weekly fee. The page gives no details on swim supervision or testing.

warnings: Today is 2026-10-13, so the 2026 season shown here (June 29–August 21, 2026) is over. The page has no 2027 dates, prices or registration details yet.
The page still says 'Summer Rec 2026 Registration is OPEN', but that season has ended.

The payment due dates look out of date and don't match the rest of the page. 'Monday July 14th' is a Tuesday in 2026, and a balance due date of August 17 for weeks 5–8 conflicts with the rule that full payment is due by the Monday of each registered week.
The intro has leftover pandemic-era wording about state and Board of Health orders. Parts of the page may be copied from earlier years.
In Week 2, the PINZ trip is labeled '(5th-6th Grade)' even though that trip day is listed for grades 5–8.
On rainy days the program moves to Wood School (72 Messenger Street), ends at 3:30 PM instead of 4 PM, and has no before or after care.
